target: S3 increment 2 — inline contract-drift logging: the brief warns on every real run when a service output is missing contract keys
findings_summary: Railway CLI not authed (can't deploy/verify a cron). Better + testable: call check_drift (S3 #599) inside _build_flood_detail/_build_bushfire_detail/_build_shadow_result against the REAL service output and logger.warning a loud CONTRACT-DRIFT line when a contract key is missing (rename/drop = the #589 silent-null). Does NOT change card behaviour (still fail-soft to None) — it makes the drift visible in prod logs on real traffic, not just a sampled cron. scripts/ is importable in prod (the brief already imports conveyancing_db). check_drift doesn't import intelligence_brief (only _registry does, lazily) so no circular import. Wrapped in try/except so drift-logging can never affect the brief.
model_design: _warn_on_drift(contract_cls, raw, service) -> logs warning if check_drift finds missing keys; called at the top of each typed _build_*. Testable via caplog.
